subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and expose unmentioned `requireMention` group media to later addressed turns, and if so under what bounded or opt-in policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the safe default from the merged Telegram media-gating PR intentionally avoids downloading unaddressed group media; changing that affects privacy, authorization, and retention semantics.

options.title: Bounded opt-in retention
options.body: Keep the current safe default and add a maintainer-approved policy that preserves only explicitly authorized recent history media with clear limits and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Unconditional retention
options.body: Record unmentioned group media whenever group history is enabled, accepting the privacy and retention tradeoff as product behavior.

options.title: Not planned
options.body: Close the request and keep unmentioned group media text-only or skipped in `requireMention` groups to avoid retaining bystander attachments.

recommendation.title: Bounded opt-in retention
recommendation.body: Keep the current safe default and add a maintainer-approved policy that preserves only explicitly authorized recent history media with clear limits and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the current safe-default skip behavior for this exact Telegram media-gating surface.
